name: Pension Maier
beschreibung: The Pension Maier is located in the village centre of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, not far from the mountain railways and popular hiking trails. The inn combines traditional Tiroler hospitality with a cosy atmosphere – rustic wooden furniture and an in-house kitchen with regional specialities shape the offering. Guests can expect comfortable rooms as well as a rustic parlour, where regional home-style cooking and relaxed socialising are the focus.
